title: Baele, Bekaert, Inghelbrecht & Wei 2020 RFS: flight-to-safety days
note: An FTS day is a large ES fall together with a large ZN rise (their threshold definition, no VIX). Test US500 and XAUUSD returns over 1-10 days after an FTS day, long or short as the paper's tables say. Data: commod ES and ZN daily. Fits gap 1 and gap 2 (indices); not a VIX-conditioned reversal. Before building: read the full paper (definitions, tables), check post-publication performance after 2018, and use data before 2025-10-13 only.

title: Da, Engelberg & Gao 2015 RFS: FEARS search index and market reversals
note: FEARS = average daily change in Google search volume for economic-fear terms (their list). A FEARS spike predicts low US500 today and a reversal over the next 2 days. Data risk: Google Trends daily data must be fetched in windows and rescaled; drop if the series cannot be rebuilt cleanly. Fits gap 1 and gap 2. Before building: read the full paper (definitions, tables), check post-publication performance after 2018, and use data before 2025-10-13 only.

title: Li & Yu 2012 JFE: nearness to the 52-week high vs the historical high
note: Nearness to the 52-week high (price / 52w high) predicts positive index returns; nearness to the all-time high predicts negative ones. Monthly signal, hold 1-3 months, on US500 / US100 / GER40 / JPN225 daily bars. Fits gap 3 (weeks+ on indices); not TSMOM, since it is an anchor ratio. Before building: read the full paper (definitions, tables), check post-publication performance after 2018, and use data before 2025-10-13 only.

title: Gilchrist & Zakrajsek 2012 AER: excess bond premium and US500
note: The Fed publishes the EBP monthly (free CSV). Rule sketch: a rising EBP over 3 months means flat or short US500 for the next month. Not the gold credit-spread idea that was rejected: this is the equity side and a different spread. Fits gap 3. Before building: read the full paper (definitions, tables), check post-publication performance after 2018, and use data before 2025-10-13 only.

title: Fisher & Statman 2000: AAII bull-bear spread as a contrarian US500 signal
note: AAII weekly survey (free history). Rule sketch: when the bull-minus-bear spread is in its top (bottom) decile over a rolling 5 years, short (long) US500 for 4-8 weeks. Not put/call (rejected); it is survey sentiment. Fits gap 3. Before building: read the full paper (definitions, tables), check post-publication performance after 2018, and use data before 2025-10-13 only.

title: Fisher & Statman 2003: consumer confidence predicts lower US500 returns
note: Michigan sentiment (FRED UMCSENT, monthly, release lag respected). Rule sketch: a high month-on-month rise means lower US500 returns the next month; trade the sign of the change. Fits gap 3. Before building: read the full paper (definitions, tables), check post-publication performance after 2018, and use data before 2025-10-13 only.

title: Huang, Jiang, Tu & Zhou 2015 RFS: aligned investor sentiment
note: PLS-aligned Baker-Wurgler sentiment proxies (Wurgler's site, monthly) forecast next-month US500 returns. Build the index recursively (no look-ahead in the PLS step). Fits gap 3. Before building: read the full paper (definitions, tables), check post-publication performance after 2018, and use data before 2025-10-13 only.

title: Brogaard & Detzel 2015 MS: EPU innovations and future US500 returns
note: Baker-Bloom-Davis EPU index (free, monthly). An EPU innovation predicts higher US500 returns over the next 2-3 months. EPU-gold was dropped as in-sample only; this is the equity test and must pass OOS after 2015. Fits gap 3. Before building: read the full paper (definitions, tables), check post-publication performance after 2018, and use data before 2025-10-13 only.

title: Goyal, Welch & Zafirov 2024 RFS: the predictors that survived out of sample
note: Read their table of the variables with positive OOS R2 after 2000 and test only those (Welch's site has the data). Rule sketch: long US500 when the forecast is above the T-bill, flat otherwise, monthly. Fits gap 3. Before building: read the full paper (definitions, tables), check post-publication performance after 2018, and use data before 2025-10-13 only.

title: Rapach, Strauss & Zhou 2010 RFS: combination forecasts of the equity premium
note: Mean of 15 single-predictor forecasts (Goyal-Welch data), recursive window. Long US500 when the combined forecast beats cash. Not the Rapach US-lead rule that was rejected. Fits gap 3. Before building: read the full paper (definitions, tables), check post-publication performance after 2018, and use data before 2025-10-13 only.

title: Cooper & Priestley 2009 RFS: the output gap predicts stock returns
note: Output gap from FRED industrial production (INDPRO), quadratic trend fitted recursively, with the release lag. A negative gap predicts higher US500 returns over the next months. Fits gap 3. Before building: read the full paper (definitions, tables), check post-publication performance after 2018, and use data before 2025-10-13 only.

title: Kelly & Pruitt 2013 JF: market expectations in the cross-section of present values
note: Three-pass regression filter on the book-to-market ratios of the French 25/100 portfolios gives a forecast of the US500 return. Build recursively; long when above cash. Fits gap 3. Before building: read the full paper (definitions, tables), check post-publication performance after 2018, and use data before 2025-10-13 only.

title: Gu, Kelly & Xiu 2020 RFS: ML market timing from macro predictors
note: Standalone monthly US500 timing model (elastic net then a small tree ensemble) on the 8 Welch-Goyal macro predictors, rolling refit, validation split before test. Not an overlay on an existing leg. Fits gap 3. Before building: read the full paper (definitions, tables), check post-publication performance after 2018, and use data before 2025-10-13 only.

title: Froot, O'Connell & Seasholes 2001 JFE flows applied to Japan MOF weekly data
note: Japan MOF publishes weekly foreign net purchases of Japanese equities (free). Rule sketch: 4-week net inflow in its top quintile means long JPN225 for 4 weeks. Froot-Ramadorai was dropped for non-free data; this uses the free MOF series. Fits gap 2 and gap 3. Before building: read the full paper (definitions, tables), check post-publication performance after 2018, and use data before 2025-10-13 only.

title: Rapach, Ringgenberg & Zhou 2016 JFE: short interest predicts the market
note: Detrended aggregate short interest (log, linear trend fitted recursively). High SII means lower US500 returns next month. Data risk: needs a free short-interest history (exchange bimonthly reports); drop if none. Fits gap 3. Before building: read the full paper (definitions, tables), check post-publication performance after 2018, and use data before 2025-10-13 only.

title: Pollet & Wilson 2010 JFE: average correlation and stock market returns
note: Average pairwise correlation of the 49 French industry portfolios' daily returns, computed each month. High average correlation predicts higher US500 returns next quarter. Fits gap 3. Before building: read the full paper (definitions, tables), check post-publication performance after 2018, and use data before 2025-10-13 only.

title: Jondeau, Zhang & Zhu 2019 JFE: average skewness predicts market returns
note: Cross-sectional average of monthly skewness of daily returns (use the 49 French industry portfolios as a proxy for stocks; note the proxy). High average skewness predicts lower US500 returns next month. Fits gap 3. Before building: read the full paper (definitions, tables), check post-publication performance after 2018, and use data before 2025-10-13 only.

title: Amihud 2002: market illiquidity and expected returns
note: Monthly |return| / dollar volume on ES (commod volume as the proxy). Unexpected illiquidity (residual of an AR(1)) lowers returns now and raises expected returns: long US500 after an illiquidity shock that has peaked. Fits gap 3 and gap 2. Before building: read the full paper (definitions, tables), check post-publication performance after 2018, and use data before 2025-10-13 only.

title: Baur & Smales 2020 JBF: geopolitical risk and gold as a hedge
note: Caldara-Iacoviello GPR index (free, daily and monthly). Rule sketch: hold XAUUSD for 4 weeks after the GPR threats index jumps above its rolling 90th percentile. Fits gap 3 (weeks+ on gold) and may help in equity sell-offs (gap 1). Before building: read the full paper (definitions, tables), check post-publication performance after 2018, and use data before 2025-10-13 only.
